Hooli Pay — Brand and Advertising Compliance Guidelines

Version 3.2, effective August 1, 2026. These rules apply to every agency that produces paid media, social content, influencer content or app store assets for Hooli Pay (the payments app and the Hooli Card) in Mexico. Owner: Hooli Pay Legal & Compliance (compliance@hoolipay.example).

Mandatory disclaimers

  • Any ad that mentions credit, interest, monthly payments, installments or the annual fee must show the CAT (Costo Anual Total) next to the offer.
  • The CAT line must be at least 50% of the font size of the main offer and stay on screen for at least 3 seconds in video.
  • The CAT line always includes its calculation date and the words "sin IVA. Para fines informativos y de comparación."
  • Never show an interest rate without the CAT in the same frame.
  • Cashback or rewards claims must state the cap and link to the terms page.
  • Hooli Pay is not a bank: never suggest that balances are protected by IPAB. Use the approved line "Hooli Pay es una Institución de Fondos de Pago Electrónico autorizada".

Prohibited claims

  • "Free" or "gratis" for any product that has conditions, fees or minimum spend.
  • "Guaranteed approval", "aprobación garantizada", "no credit check" or "sin revisar buró".
  • Superlatives we cannot prove, such as "the best card in Mexico" or "the cheapest".
  • Comparisons that name a bank or another fintech.
  • Messages that push people into debt or play on financial distress ("pay off all your debts today").
  • Images of piles of cash, minors using the app, or testimonials from people who are not real customers with a signed release.

Logo and color rules

  • Primary color: Hooli Violet #5B2EFF. Secondary color: Mint #3DDC97. Never recolor the logo.
  • Over photos, the logo always sits on the white safe container. Clear space around it equals the height of the "H".
  • Minimum logo size: 24 px in digital, 12 mm in print.
  • Do not rotate, stretch, outline or add shadows to the logo. The only approved animation is the 0.8-second logo intro from the brand portal.
  • Card images: use only the official 3D renders of the Hooli Card from the brand portal; never mock up your own card.
  • Typeface: Hooli Sans for every headline and legal line; no substitutes.

Legal review and approvals

  • Submit final assets through the compliance request form; drafts are not reviewed.
  • Standard turnaround is 3 business days. Anything mentioning credit, CAT, rates or rewards takes 5 business days.
  • Urgent fixes to an already-approved piece are reviewed within 24 hours, with a limit of 2 urgent requests per month.
  • Every piece needs two approvals: Brand Marketing and Legal & Compliance. Credit-related pieces also need sign-off from Credit Risk.
  • Influencer content needs Legal approval of the script and again of the final cut.
  • Approvals expire after 90 days, or earlier if the CAT changes.
  • No campaign goes live on a Friday after 3:00 p.m. Mexico City time or on a Mexican bank holiday.

Breaches and takedowns

  • When Legal flags a live ad as non-compliant, the agency must pause it within 2 hours of the notice.
  • The agency documents the root cause and the fix in the shared compliance log within 2 business days.
  • A second breach in the same quarter triggers a penalty of 10% of that month's agency fee.
